key_moments: Goal by Matías Galarza (Paraguay) in the 2nd minute, the fastest of the tournament so far.
Red card for Miguel Almirón (Paraguay) before halftime (45+2') for a confrontational situation.
Türkiye's Can Uzun missed a major opportunity to equalize in the 75th minute.
Merih Demiral (Türkiye) headed wide from close range in stoppage time (90+4').

standout_performers.reason: Scored the decisive early goal that secured the win.
Provided the assist for the goal and was a key attacking threat.
Held firm with 10 men for the entire second half against relentless pressure.
Orchestrated many of Türkiye's attacks but couldn't find the breakthrough.

matches.tactical_summary: Paraguay secured an early lead and then adopted a highly defensive posture, which became even more pronounced after a first-half red card. Türkiye dominated possession and launched numerous attacks in the second half but struggled to break down Paraguay's disciplined ten-man defense, lacking a clinical finish.

narrative: Paraguay secured a vital 1-0 victory over Türkiye, with Matías Galarza scoring the fastest goal of the tournament just 64 seconds into the match. Despite playing the entire second half with 10 men after Miguel Almirón's red card, Paraguay's resolute defense held firm against Türkiye's relentless attacks. This result not only earned Paraguay their first points but also confirmed Türkiye's elimination from the World Cup and ensured the USA won Group D.
